meta.name: ai-baoyu-article-illustrator
meta.description: 文章配图助手适合内容创作者、市场营销、运营、内容媒体在用户提出“文章配图够好吗”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成内容诊断、结构化优化建议、可执行发布清单。

copy.tagline: 根据文章内容自动生成配图建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常为文章找配图而烦恼
copy.tagline_en: Generate illustration suggestions based on article content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle to find images for your articles

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你提供的文章或内容材料，输出内容诊断、结构化优化建议和可执行发布清单，帮你判断配图是否合适并给出改进方向。
howto.when: 当你问“文章配图够好吗”或需要内容诊断、优化建议时触发。也适用于内容创作者、运营等需要快速评估文章配图的场景。

say.text: 帮我看看这篇文章的配图够好吗？
say.note: Claude 会分析并给出诊断和建议。

say.text: 分析这篇草稿，给出配图优化建议。
say.note: 需提供草稿内容或链接。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes your article or content materials and outputs content diagnosis, structured optimization suggestions, and an actionable publishing checklist to help you evaluate if illustrations are appropriate and how to improve.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "Are the article illustrations good enough?" or need content diagnosis and optimization suggestions. Also suitable for content creators and operators needing quick article illustration evaluation.

say_en.text: Check if the illustrations in this article are good enough.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and give diagnosis and suggestions.

say_en.text: Analyze this draft and give illustration optimization suggestions.
